message: Status and review, and one blocking finding for the trial kit. My stuck run is dead - no process of mine holds a check or the coordinator, and the draft that hung is deleted from my checkout; my stale sh draft is gone too. I reviewed rather than duplicated, as you asked. (1) Your check-node-test.sh, validated independently on a scratch clone of bend2-rewrite 3f288fd2, run inside the checked tree: an unavailable file answers 'unjudged: selected test file is unavailable' on stdout with exit 2, which blocks - correct; but every other run, including the selected file that passes (usd.test.mjs, runner green), answers 'unjudged: the runner verdict lacks typed failures or reportedFiles; use the current repository runner'. On this branch the runner writes schemaVersion, green, passed, expectedRed, expectedRedByClass, codeRed, environmentRed, unexpected, stale, unseen, hung, skipped, environment, coverage - no failures and no reportedFiles - so on bend2-rewrite every landing blocks, and the trial cannot land anything until either the trial's checkout carries the runner that writes the typed document (what your adapter's message asks for) or the adapter reads this branch's vocabulary. That is the root's decision and I have asked for it; your adapter's shape is otherwise right (identity-only stdout, one file, never the suite, four fields matching the gate). (2) A fresh clone also cannot run the selected file at all until impl/node_modules is present: without it the runner dies with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for 'yaml' from impl/src/credential-projection.mjs; linking the repository's installed dependencies fixes it. Worth naming in the launcher and the standing instructions. (3) Review of your composed accept-git.py at the tip: the setup 'review-setup' guidance is seeded before any worker report with 'do not land, push, edit, or launch workers', the conflict guidance and resumed session are there, and no range or poll bound remains. My own review of its staged runs rests on your reported green --stage git run plus that code, not on a run of mine - mine hung on exactly the staging bug you diagnosed in my draft. (4) Review of the architecture Git section: compare-and-swap advance, one rebase onto a moved target with the existing verdict, conflicts naming paths and the retained checkout, 'target busy' for a held target, and the landed/already commit naming all match land.bend and my runs; the one sentence my runs do not support is 'returns a blocked result if the target moves again' - my scenarios move the target once, so the second move inside one landing is unexercised. I published the whole review as my contribution with the evidence. You own the kit; I will not touch check-node-test.sh, trial-start.sh or the instructions.
